articles.title_zh: 葡萄牙、斯洛伐克和挪威加入自动驾驶车辆跨境测试床倡议
articles.title_original: Portugal, Slovakia and Norway join cross-border initiative on autonomous vehicle testbeds
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日，葡萄牙、斯洛伐克和挪威在布鲁塞尔“连接欧洲日”期间签署《自动驾驶车辆大规模跨境测试床联合意向声明》，西班牙于上周签署，参与国总数增至22个。该倡议依据《欧洲汽车行动计划》启动，旨在汇集成员国、非欧盟国家、地区和地方当局、产业利益相关方及运输运营商，以安全、协调和竞争的方式加速自动驾驶车辆在欧洲的统一商业化预部署。联合声明最初于6月由18个成员国签署。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: Today, Portugal, Slovakia and Norway signed the Joint Declaration of Intent on large-scale cross-border testbeds for autonomous vehicles during Connecting Europe Days in Brussels. Spain signed the Declaration last week, bringing the total number of participating countries to 22. The additional signatories reflect the continued commitment to accelerate the harmonised deployment of autonomous vehicles across Europe in a safe, coordinated and competitive way, building on the initiative launched under the European Automotive Action Plan. Background The large-scale cross-border testbed initiative for autonomous vehicles was launched under the European Automotive Action Plan. It aims to support the harmonised commercial pre-deployment of autonomous vehicles across Europe by bringing together Member States, non-EU countries, regional and local authorities, industry stakeholders and transport operators. articles.title_zh: 欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩将为2026年欧洲互联日开幕
articles.title_original: President von der Leyen to open Connecting Europe Days 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日至10月1日，欧盟委员会旗舰交通与出行活动“欧洲互联日2026”在布鲁塞尔举行，冯德莱恩将于次日14:00 CEST开幕致辞。活动聚焦跨欧洲交通网络（TEN-T）建设、消除瓶颈、提升交通韧性与军事机动性、保障基础设施投资，并讨论海事、港口、高速铁路与客运联通等议题。会议期间将签署希腊、保加利亚和罗马尼亚关键交通链接跨境合作新行动计划。该活动为政策与实施公告，涉及交通基础设施与货运通道，但未明确针对重卡或商用车排放法规。
articles.source_name: 欧盟委员会交通与运输总司
articles.content_evidence: Today marks the start of Connecting Europe Days 2026, the European Commission's flagship event for transport and mobility, taking place from 28 September to 1 October in Brussels. It will bring together leading politicians, industry representatives and the Commission to discuss key transport issues and their role in boosting Europe's competitiveness, connectivity and resilience, including military mobility and defence, across the 27-member bloc and beyond. President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen will deliver a speech during the opening ceremony tomorrow at 14.00 CEST. You can follow it live on EBS+. Ahead of the opening ceremony, President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, said: "Transport turns the promise of a connected Europe into an everyday experience. articles.title_zh: 印度车辆电动化就业影响评估
articles.title_original: Employment implications of vehicle electrification under alternative fuel efficiency pathways in India - International Council on Clean Transportation
articles.summary_zh: 国际清洁交通委员会发布报告，评估印度汽车行业从内燃机向电动汽车转型的就业影响。报告基于2024年世界投入产出数据，构建合成电动汽车部门，模拟三种电动化情景至2040年。结果显示，在高度电动化情景下，电动汽车制造业直接就业将从2024年约9万增至2040年430万，若实现电池本地化则超700万；间接就业达1730万。但净就业影响在电池本地化低于25%时为负，超过25%后转正。报告建议设定严格能效标准、实现电池本地化目标（2032年30%，2040年50%），并实施公正转型计划。
articles.source_name: 国际清洁交通委员会 ICCT
articles.content_evidence: Report Employment implications of vehicle electrification under alternative fuel efficiency pathways in India Overview India’s automotive sector is a cornerstone of the national economy, contributing approximately 7.1% of national gross domestic product (GDP) and supporting nearly 30 million direct and indirect jobs. Specifically, it estimates the direct and indirect employment impacts of electrification under corporate average fuel efficiency (CAFE) norms of varying stringency levels. Using a demand-driven input–output (IO) framework based on an updated 2024 World Input-Output Database (WIOD) dataset for India, we developed a “synthetic” EV sector to explicitly model the distinct production structure of electric vehicles. articles.title_zh: 印度电动汽车转型：2024至2050年电动汽车电池需求对进口支付的影响
articles.title_original: India’s EV transition: Impact of electric vehicle battery demand on import payments from 2024 to 2050 - International Council on Clean Transportation
articles.summary_zh: 国际清洁交通委员会发布工作论文，研究印度电动汽车转型中电池需求对进口支付的影响。印度纯电动汽车销量快速增长，但电池几乎全靠进口。研究模拟2024至2050年所有主要道路车辆（包括卡车）的电池需求，评估不同本土制造路径对石油和电池进口费用的影响。结果显示，即使电池依赖进口，快速电动化也能大幅降低进口费用，2050年雄心情景下进口账单比基准情景低61%。本土电池制造可进一步节省310亿美元。
articles.source_name: 国际清洁交通委员会 ICCT
articles.content_evidence: Working Paper India’s EV transition: Impact of electric vehicle battery demand on import payments from 2024 to 2050 India’s battery electric vehicle (BEV) sales have grown rapidly, with a compound annual growth rate of 62.5% from fiscal year (FY) 2019–20 to FY 2024–25. Yet this growth has not been matched by growth in domestic battery manufacturing and India’s battery cell demand is currently met almost entirely through imports. As BEV adoption accelerates further, battery imports may continue to grow if local battery manufacturing supply chains remain inadequate, even as reliance on imported petrol and diesel declines. This study models India’s battery demand across all major on-road vehicle segments, including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger cars, light commercial vehicles, buses, and trucks, from 2024 to 2050 under three BEV uptake scenarios. It then assesses how different levels of domestic battery manufacturing pathways could affect India’s combined oil and battery import
articles.document_type: 研究报告, 政策分析

articles.title_zh: 危险材料：纳入ASME第XII卷及国家检验规范
articles.title_original: Hazardous Materials: Incorporation of ASME Code Section XII and the National Board Inspection Code
articles.summary_zh: 美国管道与危险材料安全管理局（PHMSA）发布最终规则，修订《危险材料条例》，以引用方式纳入2015版ASME锅炉与压力容器规范第XII卷（运输罐建造与持续使用规则）及2015版国家检验规范第2、3部分（含补充6）。该规则适用于特定规格的货物罐车（MC 331、338及DOT 406、407、412）、低温便携式罐（UN T75）和多单元罐车罐（DOT 106A、110AW）。制造商可选择按第XII卷或继续按第VIII卷第1分卷建造。自愿合规日期为2026年9月28日，生效日期为2026年10月28日。PHMSA预计年化净成本节约约810万美元。

articles.title_zh: 美国环保署批准加州圣华金谷2008年臭氧标准机动车排放预算修订
articles.title_original: Approval and Promulgation of Implementation Plans; California; San Joaquin Valley, Revisions to Motor Vehicle Emissions Budgets for Ozone
articles.summary_zh: 美国环保署发布最终规则，批准加州圣华金谷地区州实施计划修订，更新2008年8小时臭氧国家环境空气质量标准下的氮氧化物和挥发性有机物机动车排放预算。新预算基于EMFAC2021模型及2025年11月批准的调整因子，覆盖2026、2029和2031年，适用于圣华金谷全部子区域，并取代此前基于EMFAC2014的旧预算。规则于2026年10月14日生效。该调整因子取消了先进清洁卡车、重型车综合法规等的排放收益，对重型商用车排放核算产生直接影响。

ACTION: Final rule. SUMMARY: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA or “Agency”) is taking final action to approve a revision to the State of California's state implementation plan (SIP) for the San Joaquin Valley (SJV) area. The revision includes an update to the SJV area's motor vehicle emissions budgets (“budgets”) for nitrogen oxides (NO X ) and volatile organic compounds (VOC) for the 2008 8-hour ozone national ambient air quality standards (NAAQS or “standards”). These updated budgets for 2026, 2029, and 2031 were developed with the latest modeling method approved for California. These updated budgets apply to all subareas within the SJV.
